defensiveAbilities.name: Evasion
defensiveAbilities.description: When Silver Saber rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Faith Bound
defensiveAbilities.description: Silver Saber can't attack a creature that openly wears or displays Achaekek's religious symbol unless that creature uses a hostile action against Silver Saber first. They can also attack a creature they believe isn't faithful to Achaekek or who wears the religious symbol as a ruse (typically after succeeding at a Perception check to Sense Motive).

defensiveAbilities.name: Reflect Truths
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. A creature that enters the area must succeed at a DC 37 Will Saving Throw save or they see their own visage in Silver Saber's reflective face looking back at them. For 1 minute, that creature can't speak any deliberate and intentional lies and takes a –2 status penalty to Deception checks. On a critical failure, the status penalty is increased to –4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Focus Gaze
offensiveAbilities.description: Silver Saber focuses their gaze on a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a Will save against Reflect Truths. If the creature was already so affected, it becomes Stunned 1. After attempting its save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of Silver Saber's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Liquefy
offensiveAbilities.description: Silver Saber becomes fully liquid and amorphous. They gain immunity to precision damage but take double cold damage. The only actions they can use while liquefied are move actions and spike ranged Strikes. They can resume their normal form by taking this action again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mirror
offensiveAbilities.description: Until the next time they act, Silver Saber appears to be a mirror. They have an automatic result of 53 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as a mirror.

offensiveAbilities.name: Silver Strikes
offensiveAbilities.description: Silver Saber's leg and spike Strikes count as silver weapons.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swift Steps
offensiveAbilities.description: Silver Saber is permanently Quickened, but they can use the extra action only to Step or Stride.
